tool.description: Compress a file (or any bytes) into a gzip (.gz) file, returned for download. level sets the deflate level 1-9 (default 6). The original filename is recorded in the gzip header and the output is named <input>.gz. Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Decompress again with gunzip.

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
